posts.body:
The Rouge In Red
​
Story
Cadeus, A young man who became a wandering rouge due to a tragic event he caused in his past, travels the land in search of four mystic relics that sealed away a dark entity he unwillingly unleashed upon the world.
He journeys to a far mountain village in search of one of the relics known as the Emerald Ring, but meets an unlikely ally that wants to be a part of his journey, whether he wants them to or not.
Will Cadeus succeed in his quest and obtain the relic, or die as someone beyond redemption? The first chapter of his tale begins here.
-A short 2-3 hour RPG
-Turn based combat
Main Characters
Spoiler
Cadeus Vermil
A young man who wanders around the land, searching for four mystical relics to seal away a great evil.
He feels as it is his responsibility due to being involved in a distaster related to those relics and the evil entity that destroyed his home,
and hopes that recovering them can help redeem him in the eyes of his people.
He usually travels with his face covered, tending to hide his real identity from people for his own reasons.
Due to the disaster, his ability to cast any magic was sapped from him, making him having to rely on his sword skills.
Velia Erwight
A spunky, energetic girl that encounters Cadeus during his journey to the mountain village. She's really intent on helping Cadeus with his quest
wanting to prove her worth to him with her archery skills, and her talent with magic.
